claims.text: Earliest layer Zhou dynasty, the Zhou Yi; 64 hexagrams of six solid or broken lines; consulted with yarrow stalks or coins; Ten Wings commentaries; canonized 136 BCE; a Jesuit noticed correspondence with binary and Leibniz claimed the hexagrams prefigured binary

'the substitution of numbers for letters of the Hebrew alphabet'; values 1–10, 20–90, 100–400; medieval Kabbalists' 'favourite method of exegesis'; sullam (ladder) = Sinai = 130; some 'condemned its use as mere toying with numbers'

Pythia, priestess of Apollo, woman over 50; consultations one day a month; bathed in Castalian spring, sat on a tripod chewing laurel leaves; priests recorded her words; peak 8th–4th c. BCE; last prophecy reportedly c. 393 CE under Theodosius I's laws

claims.text: Dee's obsidian 'spirit mirror' in the British Museum; Antiquity study led by Stuart Campbell matched it by XRF to obsidian from Pachuca, near Mexico City, under Aztec control; mirrors as gateways to other worlds; Tezcatlipoca 'Smoking Mirror'; route to Europe unclear

entries.topic: Harvard Divinity School, Center for the Study of World Religions, "The Holy Inquisition and the Genesis of Seventeenth-Century Peyote Banning"

claims.text: 1571 General Edict of Faith condemned sacramental and divinatory peyote use; Salcedo report 28 April 1619 requested by the Inquisition; edict of 9 June 1620 to prevent 'heresy, idolatry, and superstition', posted on church and convent doors in New Spain, New Galicia, Guatemala, Nicaragua, Yucatán, Verapaz, Honduras, the Philippines; practitioners adopted Catholic names such as Santa Rosa as cover

claims.text: Jesuits judged rites honouring Confucius and ancestors probably not superstitious; Dominicans and Franciscans opposed; Propaganda condemned 1645, lifted 1656; Clement XI banned 1704, bull 1715; Benedict XIV reaffirmed 1742 and forbade debate; 1939 decree 'authorized Christians to take part in ceremonies honouring Confucius' and ancestral rites

Hydesville NY, March 1848, Kate and Margaret Fox report rappings as spirit communication; 1849 Rochester Corinthian Hall first paid Spiritualist event; 21 Oct 1888 Margaret confessed hoax at New York Academy of Music before ~2,000, produced raps by cracking toe joints; retracted Nov 1889; both died poor (1892, 1893)

Remote viewing research from 1972 at SRI (Targ, Puthoff); CIA SCANATE 1970; Army INSCOM from 1977, DIA, CIA; combined as Stargate 1991; 1995 AIR review: Utts argued psychic functioning, Hyman called it premature/unreplicated; 'no remote viewing report ever provided actionable information for any intelligence operation'; CIA ended and declassified it 1995; CREST release January 2017

claims.text: 2000: first US regulatory approval to resume psychedelic research; 2006 single-dose psilocybin study, 'mystical-type experiences having substantial and sustained personal meaning'; 2014 smoking; 2016 cancer distress; 2019 Center for Psychedelic and Consciousness Research funded by private donors; 2020 depression study
